title: Ledger Consensus Finality Classifier
description: Classifies a ledger-consensus position under a deadline-bounded-inclusion model (XRPL) or a federated-BFT model (Stellar SCP), each expressed as terminal outcome branches rather than a monotone tier ladder. Flags an overstated finality claim and a fee-consuming tec final failure, and names the unprovable-absence gap where validated history is not continuous. Zero PII. Client-side. Works offline.
regulation: Ledger settlement finality policy. Corridor cutoffs are a firm policy input, not a legal determination.

mcp_tool_definition.name: classify_ledger_consensus_finality
mcp_tool_definition.description: Classify a ledger-consensus position under deadline_bounded_inclusion (XRPL) or federated_bft (Stellar SCP) and flag an overstated finality claim. Caller-supplied signed ledger facts only: no live network fetch, no witness/light-client infrastructure, no embedded validator-list snapshot. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/art-527-classify-ledger-consensus-finality.html for interactive use.

as_of_ts.description: Evaluation time as epoch seconds, caller-supplied

required_tier.description: Corridor policy cutoff expressed in the model's own outcome vocabulary

claimed_tier.description: Optional counterparty/upstream finality assertion to adjudicate

chain_label.description: Optional free text, echoed verbatim. Not an enum, no ledger-name validation table.

last_ledger_sequence.description: deadline_bounded_inclusion only: XRPL LastLedgerSequence submission deadline

submitted_at_ledger.description: deadline_bounded_inclusion only: ledger index at submission

included_in_ledger.description: deadline_bounded_inclusion only: ledger index of inclusion, if any

ledger_validated.description: deadline_bounded_inclusion only: whether included_in_ledger is itself validated

highest_validated_ledger.description: deadline_bounded_inclusion only: highest ledger index the caller has validated

continuous_history_ok.description: deadline_bounded_inclusion only: caller-attested gap-free validated ledger history over the submission range

claimed_outcome.description: deadline_bounded_inclusion only: optional counterparty assertion in this model's outcome vocabulary

externalized.description: federated_bft only: whether the transaction is included in an externalized (final) ledger

quorum_slice_trust_ok.description: federated_bft only: caller-attested trust in the relied-upon quorum slice(s)

issuer_clawback_enabled.description: federated_bft only: optional, Stellar-native issuer-clawback capability on the asset

time_bounds_max.description: federated_bft only: optional maxTime bound on the transaction
